title: A Family of Five Just Walked In

scenes.say: Two high chairs, one stroller, zero free tables.
What happens next. You push two tables together. You find the crayons. And the big one: somehow, a croissant ends up under every chair.

scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.say: Sorry about the mess. The kids say it's the best cafe in town.

props.name: Leo
props.quote: The kids say it's *the best cafe in town*.

scenes.say: Tag a cafe that makes room for families. Follow for more cafe life.
